locked_definition: UK Biobank field 1200: usually having trouble falling asleep or waking during the night versus never/rarely or sometimes
reviewed_construct: Frequent initiation/maintenance complaints; diagnostic criteria not required
interpretation_restriction: Do not equate with clinical insomnia disorder; public UKB-only release

locked_definition: Continuous self-reported sleep duration in hours
reviewed_coding: Hours over 24h including naps; whole-hour responses
interpretation_restriction: Main-period actigraphy and reported 24h sleep are related nonidentical constructs

locked_definition: Self-reported sleep duration <7 h; 7–8 h controls
higher_effect_interpretation: greater liability to reported sleep under 7 hours
interpretation_restriction: Controls shared with long sleep; beta is linear mixed-model scale

locked_definition: Self-reported sleep duration >=9 h; 7–8 h controls
higher_effect_interpretation: greater liability to reported sleep of at least 9 hours
interpretation_restriction: Controls shared with short sleep; beta is linear mixed-model scale

locked_definition: Definitely or more a morning person versus definitely or more an evening person in UK Biobank field 1180
reviewed_coding: Morning categories vs evening categories; unknown/prefer-not omitted
interpretation_restriction: Not article primary ordinal or larger meta-analysis; not objective circadian phase

reviewed_coding: Four ordered response levels analyzed as continuous
interpretation_restriction: Not hours, Epworth score, MSLT, hypersomnia or narcolepsy

reviewed_coding: Never/rarely, sometimes, usually analyzed as continuous
interpretation_restriction: No duration/timing/intent; selected no-BMI UKB member

locked_definition: UK Biobank field 1210: yes versus no to whether a partner, close relative, or friend complains about the participant's snoring
reviewed_coding: Yes/no respondent report of complaints; unknown/prefer-not omitted
interpretation_restriction: Historical direct-proxy mode wording overstates who completed the item; not diagnosed apnea

locked_definition: FinnGen R9 G6_SLEEPAPNO: hospital-discharge or cause-of-death ICD-10 G47.3 / ICD-9 3472, with G6_NARCOCATA and G6_SLEEPDISOTH excluded from controls
interpretation_restriction: Do not certify pure OSA/subtype/severity; official 3472A cataplexy/narcolepsy table anomaly unresolved

interpretation_restriction: Shared numerator with duration; quiet wake possible; not PSG sleep efficiency
